DISCOVER introduces a modular symbolic regression framework integrating dimensional consistency via `pint`, enabling hard constraints on valid expressions. It solves an NP-hard L0-regularized least squares problem using multiple sparse solvers—OMP, MIQP, simulated annealing—each approximating the optimal sparse solution. This dual focus on physical plausibility and computational efficiency allows for rapid discovery of interpretable equations from tabular data. The framework's strength lies in its ability to prune invalid candidates early, reducing search space while maintaining fidelity to domain knowledge. Its reliance on user-specified physics constraints and unit systems ensures that discovered models align with known physical principles. However, the assumption of linearity in symbolic features may limit expressiveness compared to full symbolic regression. Failure modes include over-restrictive constraints excluding valid solutions and insufficient sparsity parameters leading to overfitting.
